workflows.name: Email Triage
workflows.description: Classify an email, decide on next action, optionally draft a reply.

workflows.name: Content Mastermind
workflows.description: Three distinct creative engines generate independently, then Content Director selects, fuses, and packages the strongest campaign portfolio.

workflows.name: Paid Campaign Builder
workflows.description: Turn one artist campaign brief into a coordinated paid-media strategy, creative testing system, and approval-ready execution packet.

workflows.name: Industry Outreach Pipeline
workflows.description: Find high-fit music-industry targets, then turn the strongest opportunities into verified, personalized, approval-ready outreach.

workflows.name: College Radio Campaign
workflows.description: Verify college and noncommercial radio targets, then turn the strongest eligible stations into approval-ready outreach and submission queues.

workflows.name: Merch Product Builder
workflows.description: Turn uploaded artwork into one production-ready Printify product, optional lifestyle mockup direction, Shopify storefront guidance when connected, and an approval-gated Merch Launch Kit.

inferredRuntimeRules: Saved agents live in the global library and are activated per workspace.
Workers page shows active agents, except system agents and hidden worker-home slugs.
Artist HQ default workers are currently branding-agent, world-builder, college-radio-agent, spotify-playlist-creator.

Campaign default workers are currently branding-agent, world-builder, college-radio-agent, spotify-playlist-creator, content-genius, scroll-stopper, anticipation-director, content-director, art-director, ad-creative-agent, ads-strategist, ads-agent, ig-trending-power-up, influencer-campaign-power-up, playlisting-power-up, record-doctor, industry-hunter.
Lab workspaces can pass defaultVisibleSlugs, currently the-excavator, reverse-magic, hooker, legendary-writer, reference-master, record-doctor.
run-agent drops missing skills/sources before session creation and includes a launch receipt.
Concierge receives broad workspace context and an active-agent capability catalog for routing.
Share Intel writes targeted workspace context docs, then the central prompt composer injects them as a dedicated Shared Intel section at agent launch.

Specialist agents do not need individual prompt edits for Shared Intel; they see only the routed docs selected for their slug. Concierge/HNIC can see all enabled context docs through its existing override.
Outputs become Finals through UI actions or the promote_output_to_final session tool; Finals are pointers to existing Output bundles, not copied assets.
Finals writes use a workspace filesystem lock under context/.locks/output-finals.lock; campaign Finals require campaignId and source Outputs cannot be deleted while still referenced.
Campaign Scheduled Work separates calendar shells from executable work orders and uses backend-owned schedule/cancel/review mutations.
Agent/workflow scheduled work completes only after terminal child state; required Outputs, missed windows, stale runs, and failures become visible attention states.

Scheduled social publishing waits at needs-approval, then the guarded native browser executor may run only the exact approved profile, payload, media bytes, and browser partition and must return a durable receipt.

Automations can queue the same typed Scheduled Work lifecycle from recurring, file, webhook, URL, or inbound-message triggers; standalone background agent/workflow runs may opt out of Calendar display.
HNIC alone receives schedule_work and can create Calendar work or queue-work Automations for agent tasks and workflow runs after confirmation.

A direct instruction or active schedule to answer comments/messages is a bounded Social Publisher engagement mandate; it does not authorize cold DMs, posts/uploads, account changes, or sensitive replies.
message_agent/spawn_session cannot exceed parent permission mode; external actions still need user approval.
trustedWorkerTools are for bounded internal work only, not sends/posts/publishing.

agents.name: HNIC
agents.description: Main work chat. Routes goals to the right workers, skills, automations, and workflows.
agents.inputs: Any goal, task, question, campaign need, automation idea, workflow idea, or worker-routing request.
agents.outputs: A direct answer, worker handoff, queued-work plan, automation/workflow draft, or approval-gated next action.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.description: Break a goal into steps and coordinate the right agents.
agents.inputs: A goal or outcome you want to achieve.
agents.outputs: A step-by-step plan with named owners, plus the executed result.

agents.name: Setup Concierge
agents.description: Guides app setup, connections, keys, services, and “how do I use this?” questions.
agents.inputs: A setup goal, pasted credential, app-feature question, broken connection, or “what do I do next?” request.
agents.outputs: A guided setup step, saved-setting plan, connection test path, app explanation, or follow-up checklist.

agents.name: Anticipation Director
agents.description: Designs credible, can’t-look-away video concepts built around visible inevitability, rising stakes, and a decisive payoff.
agents.inputs: Song, campaign, existing concept, setting, performance idea, production limits, locked elements, or desired emotional charge.
agents.outputs: Anticipation concepts with opening frame, kinetic clock, stakes, peak moment, resolution, execution illusion, and anti-corny diagnosis.

agents.name: Content Director
agents.description: Selects, strengthens, and fuses creative concepts into a campaign-ready content portfolio.
agents.inputs: Campaign context plus concepts from creative agents, existing ideas, references, constraints, assets, budget, and release goals.
agents.outputs: A Canvas-ready Content Portfolio containing a Big Swing, flagship concepts, repeatable formats, supporting ideas, fast wins, production priorities, and campaign sequencing.

agents.name: Hypermotion Agent
agents.description: Create polished motion graphics, Spotify Canvas loops, captions, and social promos.
agents.inputs: A motion/video brief, assets, target platform, duration, format, brand direction, or existing artifact to animate or render.
agents.outputs: Canvas-ready HTML previews, Spotify Canvas loops, MP4 renders, poster frames, asset folders, render receipts, and clear next actions.

agents.name: Lottie Animation Agent
agents.description: Create lightweight web and app animations.
agents.inputs: A Lottie animation brief, SVG/path/image reference, timing direction, target platform, dimensions, FPS, duration, and desired editable controls.
agents.outputs: A verified public/lottie.json animation, optional public/controls.json, preview URL, key-frame checks, and embed guidance for web, mobile, or app use.

agents.name: Lyric Video
agents.description: Creates single lyric clips from song audio, lyrics, image refs or visual assets, captions, and FFmpeg renders.
agents.inputs: Song audio, lyrics or timed lyric lines, visual source or image reference, platform/aspect ratio, duration, caption style, and output destination.
agents.outputs: A single rendered MP4, render report, caption timing notes, and clear blockers when audio/lyrics/visuals are missing.

agents.name: Raw Video Editor
agents.description: Edit existing raw footage into polished clips, reels, shorts, interviews, and social cutdowns.
agents.inputs: A folder of existing video/audio files, desired platform/aspect ratio, target runtime, pacing direction, must-keep moments, must-cut moments, caption style, and brand/editing notes.
agents.outputs: An edit folder with inventory, packed transcript, EDL, preview/final MP4 paths, self-check notes, and clear limits when source media or transcription is missing.

agents.name: Scroll Stopper
agents.description: Invents absurd, polarizing AI-video concepts with hard cover-shot direction and paste-ready vertical generation prompts.
agents.inputs: Campaign context, artist world, content lane, platform, niche, vibe, constraints, reference ideas, or a rough premise that needs to become a vertical AI-video concept.
agents.outputs: Scroll-stopping short-form concepts with loglines, lever/setting/character/trigger tags, cover-shot art direction, safety notes, and ready-to-paste 9:16 AI-video prompts.

agents.name: Video Director
agents.description: Plan, storyboard, and produce approval-gated generative videos with Squad.
agents.inputs: Video briefs, UGC/ad/app-demo/music/faceless narrative ideas, local assets, creative direction, platform requirements, and approval-gated production requests.
agents.outputs: No-spend storyboard boards, recipe recommendations, preflight reports, production plans, staged MP4 outputs, manifests, review packets, and Canvas previews.

agents.name: Video Editor Agent
agents.description: Assemble footage, captions, images, and audio into edited videos.
agents.inputs: A video brief, local media files, caption/transcript files, target platform, aspect ratio, duration, pacing direction, and export needs.
agents.outputs: A valid .runner-video.json project, registered media, timeline clips, simple MP4 renders for video/image/audio/text timelines, placeholder export receipts, and clear render-limit notes.

agents.name: Art Director
agents.description: Create highly aesthetic single and album art, merch, posters, and campaign visuals.
agents.inputs: Artist HQ Profile, Voice, Branding, themes, similar artists, music style, song/release notes, lyrics, references, approved artist photos and face references, cover/merch mode, format, and generation approval.
agents.outputs: Taste-led visual concepts, style-lane recommendations, album/single art prompts, merch graphic specs, reference-image requirements, typography/layout direction, SVG/PNG artwork composition exports, Canvas-visible artifacts, anti-slop checks, and approved image-generation/layout briefs.

agents.name: Content Genius
agents.description: Plan short-form content ideas, then finish locked ideas with captions and overlays that command attention.
agents.inputs: Campaign context, artist/profile voice, audience, platform, rough idea, clip notes, script, trend, post goal, or content pillar.
agents.outputs: Short-form content concepts, hook angles, scene/opening ideas, caption hooks, on-screen text overlays, and native caption variants ready for approval or handoff.

agents.name: Legendary Minds
agents.description: Pressure-test ideas through Kurt Cobain, David Bowie, Kanye West, Tom Ford, Jobs, and MrBeast lenses.
agents.inputs: A product, brand, offer, script, video idea, campaign, deck, launch plan, or creative decision that needs a persona-led critique.
agents.outputs: A persona-lens critique with the strongest verdicts, contradictions, recommended edits, and next creative move.

agents.name: Legendary Writer
agents.description: Songwriting coach and lyric surgeon grounded in The Yoga of Songwriting.
agents.inputs: Lyrics, rough sections, song concept, artist context, references, or a specific writing block.
agents.outputs: A concise lyric diagnosis, section surgery, rewrite options, stronger hooks, and next writing moves.

agents.name: Record Doctor
agents.description: Submit a song for premium producer vetting, feedback, or enhancement by sending a clean approval-gated packet to mikeymikemusic@gmail.com.
agents.inputs: Song file/link, artist name, song title, desired review goal, song notes, references, timeline, contact info, and approval to send.
agents.outputs: A Record Doctor submission packet, producer email draft to mikeymikemusic@gmail.com, approval checklist, Gmail draft/send receipt when connected, or manual copy-paste packet.

agents.name: World Builder
agents.description: Design immersive low-budget release worlds fans can enter, built from the song's actual emotional world instead of generic promo tactics.
agents.inputs: Song title, lyrics, demo/file/link, Artist HQ Profile, Voice, Branding, campaign brief, mood, visual world, release date, audience size, budget, and artist willingness to commit.
agents.outputs: A song-world map, central immersive mechanic, anti-corny law check, spokes, rollout sequence, feasibility notes, and failure-mode de-risking.

agents.name: Print Agent
agents.description: Turn artwork into print-on-demand merch plans and product drafts.
agents.inputs: Image folders, artwork files, shirt/product ideas, Printify shop tasks, product batches, pricing, placement, catalog, upload, order, and fulfillment requests.
agents.outputs: Asset inventories, product plans, placement specs, Printify manifests, upload/product approval packets, QA reports, receipts, and Canvas-ready previews.

agents.name: Shopify Agent
agents.description: Manage Shopify products, listings, inventory, and store updates.
agents.inputs: Shopify product, collection, inventory, order, customer, discount, listing copy, pricing, merchandising, or store-operation requests.
agents.outputs: Store diagnostics, product/listing plans, draft mutations, approval packets, reports, receipts, and Canvas-ready artifacts.

agents.name: Coder
agents.description: Writes, refactors, and debugs code with attention to convention.
agents.inputs: A code change request, bug report, or codebase to modify.
agents.outputs: Code edits matching the project's conventions, with tests and root-cause notes.

agents.name: Update System Agent
agents.description: Check installed tools, agents, and skills before updates.
agents.inputs: A request to check whether RunnerOS tools, agents, skills, sources, CLIs, packages, or integrations need updates or cleanup.
agents.outputs: A short maintenance report with blockers, needs-review items, safe follow-ups, and exact next commands.

agents.name: Hooker
agents.description: Writes, diagnoses, and upgrades song hooks, choruses, refrains, and title lines.
agents.inputs: A song concept, verse, existing hook, chorus draft, title line, genre, ambition, or rhythmic pocket.
agents.outputs: Hook candidates, chorus punch-ups, title-line options, diagnosis, setup fixes, and singability notes.

agents.name: Open Slide
agents.description: Create clean slide decks and export them to HTML or PDF.
agents.inputs: A deck brief (topic, audience, length, tone), or an existing deck to edit/export.
agents.outputs: A static HTML build (and optional PDF) of the deck, published as a Canvas-visible Output. Edit URL and dist path included.

agents.name: Reference Master
agents.description: Finds fresh cultural allusions, imagery wells, and reference palettes for songs.
agents.inputs: A theme, mood, lyric, song concept, artist context, or a cultural well the writer leans on.
agents.outputs: Fresh reference palettes grouped by well, meaning, lyric-use notes, cliche warnings, and optional lines/images to save into the Lab.

agents.name: Reverse Magic
agents.description: Turns song annotations and reference psychology into wholly new original lyrics.
agents.inputs: A reference artist/song, Genius annotations or song-analysis notes, and the new song concept.
agents.outputs: A new original song draft built from the reference psychology, with section notes and annotation-bait reasoning.

agents.name: The Excavator
agents.description: Finds the buried song idea when the writer feels blocked or generic.
agents.inputs: Writer block, loose life details, a flat draft, a vague theme, or a need for a song prompt.
agents.outputs: One-question-at-a-time digs, song titles, first lines, charged concepts, and follow-up doors for writing.

agents.name: Writer
agents.description: Drafts and edits prose with a clear, direct voice.
agents.inputs: A topic + audience, or an existing draft to revise.
agents.outputs: A clean draft (or edited version) in a direct, specific voice.

agents.name: College Radio
agents.description: Match releases to college and non-commercial radio stations, verify fit, and prepare rule-aware outreach packets.
agents.inputs: Artist HQ and campaign context, song/release, genre and vibe, 2–5 sound-alikes, clean/explicit status, hometown, tour markets, release type, stream/download links, and physical-format availability.
agents.outputs: Ranked verified station shortlist, send-first tier, rules watch-list, submission path, personalized pitch drafts, follow-up plan, and Outreach Agent handoff packet.

agents.name: Comms Agent
agents.description: Draft artist communications for fans, press, partners, collaborators, community, and team using Profile, Voice, Branding, and campaign context.
agents.inputs: Artist HQ Profile, Voice, Branding cards, Intel reports, release/campaign context, audience segment, offer/news, links, facts, approvals, and send channel.
agents.outputs: Fan emails, newsletters, SMS/community updates, press pitches, collaborator asks, internal updates, send-readiness checklists, and approval packets.

agents.name: Industry Hunter
agents.description: Find the right A&Rs, label operators, managers, publishers, sync people, and industry connectors, then output an Outreach-ready target list.
agents.inputs: Artist HQ Profile, Voice, Branding, themes, music style, related artists, campaign/release goal, links, songs, lyrics, demos, and target market.
agents.outputs: A ranked Industry Hunter Target List with names, roles, likely LinkedIn/profile URLs, source links, fit rationale, outreach angles, confidence, missing info, and Outreach Agent handoff prompts.

agents.name: Outreach Agent
agents.description: Find anyone's email via LinkedIn URL, research the person for personalized outreach, draft and send high rapport email.
agents.inputs: Person name, LinkedIn profile URL, outreach goal, relationship context, offer/ask, sender identity, artist/team context, and approval to send.
agents.outputs: Confirmed email lookup result, prospect intel brief, hook/angle options, polished outreach draft, subject lines, copy-paste packet, approval checklist, and Gmail send receipt when connected and approved.

agents.name: Triager
agents.description: Sorts incoming items (emails, messages, issues) into next actions.
agents.inputs: An unsorted list of items (emails, messages, issues, tasks).
agents.outputs: Each item grouped by urgency with a single-verb next action and owner.

agents.name: Ad Creative
agents.description: Researches and finds high-performing artist ads, then helps craft creative, hooks, copy, and variants for paid campaigns.
agents.inputs: Artist context, strategy packet, platform, goal, creative assets, lyrics, clips, visuals, comments, destination, and brand constraints.
agents.outputs: Ad Creative Packet with angles, hooks, copy variants, format plan, diversity check, fatigue refresh plan, policy risk, and execution handoff.

agents.name: Ad Runner
agents.description: Plan, review, and run Meta, Google, Spotify ads.
agents.inputs: Meta Ads, Google Ads, or Spotify Ads account, campaign, ad set/ad group, ad, keyword, search term, budget, conversion, reporting question, or Spotify for Artists audience intel.
agents.outputs: Clear paid-media findings, diagnostics, reports, proposed changes, and approval-ready action plans.

agents.name: Ad Strategy
agents.description: Builds Meta, Google, and Spotify paid-ad campaign strategy, budget, audience, territory, and testing plans from artist context before Ad Runner executes.
agents.inputs: Artist context, campaign/release goal, budget, platform scope, territories, destination URL, prior ad/export data, Spotify for Artists intel, and creative assets.
agents.outputs: Ads Strategy Packet with platform rationale, campaign architecture, audience/territory plan, budget split, test plan, and execution handoff fields.

agents.name: Branding Agent
agents.description: Build artist brand DNA, mythology, narrative universe, visual world, campaign angles, and subtle public behavior.
agents.inputs: Artist HQ Profile, Voice, Branding cards, Intel reports, lyrics, songs, visuals, captions, references, campaign goals, or a brand problem.
agents.outputs: Brand DNA audits, narrative universes, belief systems, visual-world direction, campaign angles, subtle behavior rules, fan rituals, and next moves.

agents.name: Critic
agents.description: Reads work and returns honest, specific, structured criticism.
agents.inputs: A finished or in-progress piece of work (writing, code, design, plan).
agents.outputs: What is working, what is not, and the single highest-leverage change.

agents.name: IG Music Trending
agents.description: Draft an inquiry to a vetted IG music trending provider.
agents.inputs: Mission/release context, promo budget, target timeline, campaign goal, and any notes for the service partner.
agents.outputs: A concise partner inquiry email draft with subject, body, missing info, and send-readiness checklist.

agents.name: Influencer Campaign
agents.description: Draft an inquiry to a vetted influencer campaign provider.
agents.inputs: Mission/release context, promo budget, target audience, influencer lane, timeline, and notes for the service partner.
agents.outputs: A concise partner inquiry email draft with subject, body, missing info, and send-readiness checklist.

agents.name: Playlisting
agents.description: Draft an inquiry to a vetted playlisting provider.
agents.inputs: Mission/release context, promo budget, genre/reference lane, release target, streaming links or asset status, and notes.
agents.outputs: A concise playlisting inquiry email draft with subject, body, missing info, and send-readiness checklist.

agents.name: Spotify Playlist Creator
agents.description: Create Spotify playlists that place your songs beside bigger artists.
agents.inputs: Artist context, playlist theme, comparable artists/tracks, real Spotify track URLs or IDs, optional BPM/energy/key data, target length, feature ratio, visibility, and connected Spotify profile.
agents.outputs: Evidence-labeled strategy, deterministic playlist plan, title/description/cover package, approval contract, and verified Spotify playlist URL receipt.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.description: Research a topic and return clear findings with sources.
agents.inputs: A topic, question, or subject area to investigate.
agents.outputs: A structured summary with TL;DR, findings, open questions, and numbered citations.

agents.name: Spotify Analyst
agents.description: Pulls Spotify artist data and turns it into useful growth signal.
agents.inputs: Artist HQ Profile, connected Spotify for Artists browser session, existing Spotify snapshots, and campaign context.
agents.outputs: Spotify for Artists snapshots, compatible delta briefs, anomaly alerts, Artist HQ context updates, and growth handoff notes.

agents.name: YouTube Intelligence Agent
agents.description: Turns trusted YouTube channels and transcripts into weekly, evidence-backed artist intelligence.
agents.inputs: YouTube channels, videos, transcripts, or a weekly intelligence brief with configured trusted channels.
agents.outputs: A report Output with timestamped findings and categorized machine-readable intelligence nuggets.

agents.name: YouTube Research Agent
agents.description: Find YouTube videos, comments, transcripts, and ideas for a campaign.
agents.inputs: Campaign brief, song ethos, audience lane, YouTube topic, keyword list, channel handle, playlist URL, video ID, transcript request, comment research, or embed-candidate task.
agents.outputs: Ranked video candidates, transcript summaries, top comments, channel scans, related-video lists, campaign-adjacent cultural notes, and embed-ready recommendations.

agents.name: Postiz
agents.description: Draft, schedule, and publish social content through Postiz.
agents.inputs: Social post request, target Postiz integration, platform, copy, media, platform settings, schedule target, campaign context, and approval status.
agents.outputs: Validated Postiz draft, exact approval packet, and provider post ID/integration receipt after approved scheduling or publishing.

agents.name: Social Publisher
agents.description: Plan social rollouts and route approved Finals through Artist OS, Postiz, or TryPost.
agents.inputs: Campaign Finals, release timing, target platforms and profiles, or a social post, reply, DM, login, or readiness request.
agents.outputs: A launch-ready social rollout, validated drafts, exact approval packet, and provider or browser receipts after approved actions.

agents.name: TryPost
agents.description: Post or schedule social content through TryPost.
agents.inputs: Social post request, platform, account/profile, copy, media paths, schedule target, campaign context, and approval status.
agents.outputs: Validated TryPost draft, approval packet, and provider post ID/status receipt after approved scheduling or publishing.
